easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Ghostly Flicker.
description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
